Fixes bug Bda0ba7b9eb: ddflow recover lists an orphan worktree whose local .ddflow/config.toml retains base_ref = "--local" (stale from before fix-B-base-ref-holds-a-flag, which now correctly REFUSES a flag-valued base_ref). recover only says 'INSPECT FIRST / salvage', but gate status/claim then fail with 'InvalidValue: invalid worktree.base_ref = --local', and nothing offers a recover/doctor sweep to repair the stale value, so B-hy-stop-protocol, fix-B2efda94671 and fix-B42016bbc0e were unreadable until a worker hand-edited base_ref to 'main'.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-Bda0ba7b9eb --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed Bda0ba7b9eb --regression-test <test>` first).
data.title: Fix bug Bda0ba7b9eb: stale base_ref flag value in orphan worktrees has no recover/doctor repair path
